allow: Bash(cd server && poetry run ruff check:*)
Bash(cd server && poetry run ruff format:*)

hooks.command: if [ -f client/package.json ] && echo '{{file}}' | grep -q '^client/.*\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|json|css)$'; then cd client && npx prettier --write '{{file}}' 2>/dev/null || true; elif [ -f server/pyproject.toml ] && echo '{{file}}' | grep -q '^server/.*\.py$'; then cd server && poetry run ruff format '{{file}}' 2>/dev/null || true; fi

echo '🔍 Running Impetus Lock quality checks...'; if [ -f server/pyproject.toml ]; then cd server && poetry run ruff check . 2>/dev/null && echo '✅ Backend lint passed' || echo '⚠️ Backend lint issues found'; poetry run mypy . 2>/dev/null && echo '✅ Backend type check passed' || echo '⚠️ Backend type issues found'; fi; if [ -f client/package.json ]; then cd client && npm run lint 2>/dev/null && echo '✅ Frontend lint passed' || echo '⚠️ Frontend lint issues found'; npm run type-check 2>/dev/null && echo '✅ Frontend type check passed' || echo '⚠️ Frontend type issues found'; fi; echo '✨ Quality checks complete'
